other_cameras_policy: Only 0100_D uses this support mask; the other 97 cameras retain their existing depth-supervision policy.
mask_policy: Keep the complete frozen R1 inside the existing 80x80m context; remove only individually recorded obvious input-inspection mistakes; do not crop to the 30x30m evaluation prism.
weight_policy: For 0100_D only: valid R1 gets alpha, valid R2/R3 get 1, R4/R5/R6/invalid get 0. use_mask=(region_id in 1,2,3)&valid. R1 is unchanged. Other 97 cameras remain unchanged.
review_policy: Only source-0 RGB, native current MVS, its derived heights and prior input depth are used; no UAS, LoD2 evaluation, evaluation camera, or optimized result is accessed.
